# Langfuse Terraform Provider

This repository contains the Langfuse provider for Terraform and OpenTofu.
Generated Go clients are built from vendored Langfuse OpenAPI specifications;
Terraform resource schemas and lifecycle behavior are currently maintained by
hand for compatibility.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): install, configure, and use the provider.
- [Development guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): prerequisites, commands, and API client workflow.
- [Testing guide](TESTING.md): unit and acceptance test setup and requirements.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): concise repository rules for coding agents.
- [Provider documentation](docs/index.md): generated resource documentation.

## Architecture and generation

- [OpenAPI generation assessment](ai-docs/openapi-provider-generation.md): generator options and migration constraints.
- [OpenAPI sprint notes](ai-docs/sprint-1/README.md): generated-client implementation status and backlog.
- [Vendored public API spec](openapi/langfuse.yml)
- [Vendored organizations API spec](openapi/langfuse-organizations.yml)
- [Public API client generator config](langfuse/publicapi/oapi-codegen.yaml)
- [Admin API client generator config](langfuse/adminapi/oapi-codegen.yaml)
- [Generation directives](tools/openapi.go)

## Key commands

- `make build`
- `make test`
- `make generate-api`
- `make check-generated`
- `make docs`
- `make testacc` (requires Docker and a Langfuse Enterprise test environment)
